Latency is the time it takes for your computer to communicate with the World of Warcraft server. A latency of 50ms means that it takes 50 milliseconds to send and receive a packet from the World of Warcraft server. For playing games online such as WoW, a low latency is desired as it means less communication time between control input and events happening on the player's screen. A high latency can become a hindrance for proper gameplay. Things that could be experienced are delayed messaging, out of sync battles and difficulty of performing tasks in-game that are required to advance. The terms "Lag" and "Ping" are often used when players refer to their current latency status.

A leader, also known as group leader (in a group) or raid leader (in a raid) is a player that's promoted to the leader of a raid or group through the game system. Usually identified by a small crown icon () near their portrait. Their purpose is to command the other players and often distribute loot through master loot. Many players in the role of a leader will however not care to act like one. This is especially the case in PuGs and BGs, where players are placed in groups or raids by the game system rather than manually creating them. Leather can mean a couple of things in World of Warcraft: # A type of skin ingredient item usually gathered with the skinning profession from a skinnable corpse. These items can usually be used directly by the leatherworking profession without prior processing or treatment. # A type of armor used by playable characters belonging to the fairly fragile, but also agile leather-wearing classes. Generally better than cloth armor for defense.See Leather armor.

His house is full of seemingly useless inventions and he has a knack for saying the wrong things at the wrong time. .]] Leap of Faith is a priest class talent that pulls a party or raid member to the priest's location. Leap of Faith (sometimes nicknamed "Life Grip") is intended to give priests a tool to help rescue fellow players who have pulled aggro, are being focused on in PvP, or just can't seem to get out of the fire in time.
League of Arathor Elites are elite humans who guard the entrance to Arathi Basin in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

Lava is molten rock that is often found in volcanic regions or in areas where metal is being forged. In-game, lava is a broad term that encompasses the real life definitions of lava, magma, and molten metal since all three look and behave identically within World of Warcraft.
